The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Two bugs were present:
1. `n_eff` only special-cased `div == 0`, but the spec requires both `div = 0` and `div = 1` to behave as `div = 2`. Fixed by checking `div < 2`.
2. `tick` used `cnt == last`, which would never fire if `div` was reduced mid-count such that `cnt` jumped past the new `last`. Fixed by using `cnt >= last`.
